summary: Tested new features: Top Picks moved to AI Trading Bot Tokens tab, new-pairs endpoint for potential runners, and Journal Insights connected to trade stats. All 15 backend tests passed. Frontend verified - AI Trader shows 'Connect wallet' when not connected (expected behavior), Journal AI shows only Chat and Insights tabs (no Top Picks).

/api/ai-trader/new-pairs endpoint exists and returns pairs array
/api/ai-trader/new-pairs returns count matching pairs array length
/api/journal/trades/{wallet}/stats returns win_rate, total_pnl, total_trades, wins, losses
Empty wallet returns default stats (0 trades, 0 win_rate, null best/worst trade)
AI Trading Bot accessible from navbar with purple styling
Journal AI Assistant shows only Chat and Insights tabs (Top Picks removed)

TopPickCard supports three types: safe, volatile, new - each with appropriate styling
New pairs endpoint filters for pairs created within 24h with min $10K liquidity and $5K volume
JournalAIAssistant only imports ChatSection and InsightsSection (TopPicksSection not imported)
InsightsSection.js fetches trade stats from /api/journal/trades/{wallet}/stats and displays Win Rate, P&L, Total Trades, Best Trade
TopPickCard shows truncated contract address with copy-to-clipboard functionality
Trade link opens DEX URL in new tab or falls back to dexscreener search
